defaults: Measurement window: Hotel opportunity-plan barrierAt + durationSeconds; TeaStore receipt window; OTel request-ledger startedAtEpoch..endedAtEpoch. Capture = everything retained in the cell.

"possible" for traces means instrumented under the posture (structural); whether the driven workload reaches the service is recorded as `expected` and used as the likely reason of a gap ("no traffic"), as section 1b lists it.

Log level classes: info; warn; error; other = trace, debug, fatal, panic (and JUL FINE/CONFIG, MariaDB none); undefined = a record whose layout carries no level (Go stdlib `log` without a gRPC severity prefix, JVM throwable headers, OTLP SeverityNumber 0 without SeverityText) plus unparsed lines. Harness lines (OBSPLACEMENT_*, OBSERVABILITY_*) are excluded from every class: they are the harness's channel, not the service's.

Log projection: a class is possible iff one of its member levels is available in the logging framework and >= the configured threshold. undefined is always possible (any process can write unlevelled stdout). Threshold unknown -> projection unknown. MariaDB `Note` is mapped to info. Go `log` lines without a gRPC severity prefix: symptoms.py maps them to info; here they are undefined (the layout carries no level).

Configured level sources: Hotel = compose env LOG_LEVEL per posture fed through the switch in tune/setting.go of the *materialized* (witness-patched) source, read with go/ast (callsites/callsites.go); TeaStore = slf4j-simple default INFO (no simplelogger.properties / defaultLogLevel in the upstream tree, checked by file walk) and Tomcat JUL default INFO (assumed: no logging.properties override in the tree); available levels exclude fatal/panic (slf4j and JUL have none). OTel = a static level the Go source sets (logrus `.Level =` / `SetLevel`), else unknown. Third-party images: unknown.

Call sites per level: counted language-aware only where a parser exists here: Go via go/ast (Hotel, OTel checkout and productcatalog), Java via the javac Tree API (TeaStore services + their in-repo Maven dependencies, OTel adservice). Vendor/library code is not counted, so app call sites == 0 at a passing level does NOT make the class not-possible (gRPC, Tomcat, runtimes log too); it is recorded (`appCallSites`) and used in the gap reason. Without a parser the cell says projectionSource `configured-level-only`.

metric:runtime is possible for every container (cgroup / docker stats). metric:app: Hotel/TeaStore app services from metric-library imports (go/ast, javac); OTel app services = SDK enabled under the posture (catalog closure, imported from research/otel-offpath/adapter.py LAYOUTS v3); otelcol = its config's prometheus self-scrape receiver; third-party images unknown.

trace projection: Hotel compose env JAEGER_DISABLED == false and JAEGER_SAMPLE_RATIO > 0; TeaStore Kieker enabled (RABBITMQ_HOST set and != "unset", upstream dockerbase start.sh) and the service's aspectj group in the posture's closure (posture-proof.json closureGroups, the harness's declared posture); OTel posture closure. Containers outside the posture's instrumentation config: not-possible (no trace exporter configured).

Observation completeness: Hotel logs complete for services built from the application source (compose `build`); Hotel traces complete only for the service Jaeger was queried for (jaeger-raw.json url `service=`), else a zero is unknown; Hotel runtime metrics complete for services in cpu.json / system-samples.json. TeaStore logs complete for services with a retained `<service>.log` (measurement-window scope, so window == capture); traces complete for all (Kieker AMQP consumer); runtime metrics for resources.json containers. OTel: traces and app metrics complete for every service (collector debug exporter sees all OTLP); OTLP logs complete for a service only if it is SDK-enabled under the posture AND emitted >= 1 OTLP log record in any parsed OTel cell (evidence of a log bridge), and never for undefined (stdout is not retained); otelcol self-metrics carry no timestamp in the parser, so their window count is unknown.

OTel compose model: upstream docker-compose.yml with .env interpolation (compose spec ${VAR}, ${VAR:-d}, ${VAR:?m}) plus the harness overlays; the materialized compose (rewritten ports) is not retained locally.

Compose models: Hotel = the compose-rendered.yml (JSON from `docker compose config`) retained in each cell, so the per-posture env (LOG_LEVEL, JAEGER_*) is what ran; TeaStore = the runtime worktree's docker-compose_kieker.yaml + docker-compose_rabbitmq.yaml + isolation.override.yaml + the posture override (none.override.yaml / compiled-<posture>.override.yaml); `environment` lists and mappings are both accepted.

Role vocabulary (ROLE_TOKENS) is a fixed table of server-product names matched as whole tokens of the image reference and the service name (no substring regex); bare `otel` and `telemetry` are deliberately absent, because OTel Demo's own application images carry them.
Ledger observed count: Hotel opportunity-ledger rows; TeaStore request rows inside journey-ledger terminal rows; OTel request-ledger rows. Ledger cells exist for the entry only.
`unconfirmed`: a not-possible cell whose channel the evidence cannot show; counted under not-possible and reported separately in the counts table.

Likely reasons are heuristics computed from the cell's own fields (the `expected` flag, window vs capture counts, app call-site count, record frameworks); they are leads to check, not verified causes.

The OTel base-run call graph needs span/parent ids, which adapter.parse_otelcol drops; otel_span_edges reads them from the same debug-exporter layout using the adapter's own _payload/_attr_value/catalog_service.
